title: OSHA general industry powered industrial trucks (forklifts) practice questions
description: Free practice questions on OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178 powered industrial trucks. Every answer is explained and linked to the section it comes from.

questions.question: Which of these vehicles is outside the scope of 29 CFR 1910.178?

options.A: A farm vehicle
options.B: A motorized hand truck
options.C: A platform lift truck
options.D: A fork truck powered by an internal combustion engine

questions.explanation: The section covers fork trucks, platform lift trucks, motorized hand trucks and similar trucks, but it "does not apply to compressed air or nonflammable compressed gas-operated industrial trucks, nor to farm vehicles".

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Under 1910.178, an "approved truck" is listed or approved for fire safety purposes for the intended use by whom?

options.A: The employer's safety committee
options.B: A nationally recognized testing laboratory
options.C: The OSHA area office
options.D: The dealer that sold the truck

questions.explanation: An approved truck is one "listed or approved for fire safety purposes for the intended use by a nationally recognized testing laboratory, using nationally recognized testing standards."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: A fork truck is fitted with a front-end attachment that was not factory installed. Under 1910.178(a)(5), what shall the user request?

options.A: A new operator certification for every driver
options.B: An OSHA variance for the attachment
options.C: A refund of the truck's original price
options.D: That the truck be marked to identify the attachments and show the approximate weight of the truck and attachment combination at maximum elevation with load laterally centered

questions.explanation: The user "shall request that the truck be marked to identify the attachments and show the approximate weight of the truck and attachment combination at maximum elevation with load laterally centered."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: What duty does 1910.178(a)(6) give the user about a truck's nameplates and markings?

options.A: To remove them once all operators are trained
options.B: To see that all are in place and maintained in a legible condition
options.C: To replace them each year with the company's own labels
options.D: To keep them in the office files rather than on the truck

questions.explanation: "The user shall see that all nameplates and markings are in place and are maintained in a legible condition."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: A new hire was already trained in some topics listed in 1910.178(l)(3), and that training suits the truck and working conditions. When does 1910.178(l)(5) say additional training in those topics is not required?

options.A: When the operator shows a certificate from any driving school
options.B: Never; every topic must be repeated for each new employer
options.C: When the earlier training took place within the last ten years
options.D: When the operator has been evaluated and found competent to operate the truck safely

questions.explanation: Additional training in that topic "is not required if the operator has been evaluated and found competent to operate the truck safely."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Which of these does 1910.178(l)(3)(ii) list as a workplace-related training topic?

options.A: The company's vacation policy
options.B: Highway traffic laws for commercial vehicles
options.C: Payroll and timekeeping procedures
options.D: Closed environments and other areas where insufficient ventilation or poor vehicle maintenance could cause a buildup of carbon monoxide or diesel exhaust

questions.explanation: The workplace-related topics include "Closed environments and other areas where insufficient ventilation or poor vehicle maintenance could cause a buildup of carbon monoxide or diesel exhaust".

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Which item must the employer's operator certification include?

options.A: The date of the evaluation
options.B: The operator's home address
options.C: The operator's Social Security number
options.D: The operator's driver's license number

questions.explanation: The certification "shall include the name of the operator, the date of the training, the date of the evaluation, and the identity of the person(s) performing the training or evaluation."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Under whose supervision may a trainee operate a powered industrial truck?

options.A: Any coworker who holds a state driver's license
options.B: The direct supervision of persons with the knowledge, training and experience to train operators and evaluate their competence
options.C: Another trainee who has finished formal instruction
options.D: Nobody, once the trainee passes a written test

questions.explanation: Trainees may operate a truck only "Under the direct supervision of persons who have the knowledge, training, and experience to train operators and evaluate their competence" and where the operation "does not endanger the trainee or other employees."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: An employee hired after December 1, 1999 will drive a powered industrial truck. Under the table in 1910.178(l)(7), by when must the initial training and evaluation be completed?

options.A: Before the employee is assigned to operate a powered industrial truck
options.B: Within 30 days after the first assignment
options.C: Within one year of the hire date
options.D: By the first three-year performance evaluation

questions.explanation: For an employee hired after December 1, 1999, the initial training and evaluation must be completed "Before the employee is assigned to operate a powered industrial truck."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: What must be done with a truck before anyone attempts to change or charge its batteries?

options.A: The truck is properly positioned and the brake applied
options.B: The electrolyte is drained from the battery
options.C: The battery compartment cover is closed and latched
options.D: The forks are raised to full height

questions.explanation: "Trucks shall be properly positioned and brake applied before attempting to change or charge batteries."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Fuel was spilled while a truck was being refueled. Under 1910.178(p)(3), what must happen before the engine is restarted?

options.A: The truck is pushed at least 8 feet away from the spill
options.B: Sawdust is spread over the spill, then the engine may be restarted
options.C: The spillage is carefully washed away or completely evaporated and the fuel tank cap replaced
options.D: The operator reports the spill at the end of the shift

questions.explanation: "Spillage of oil or fuel shall be carefully washed away or completely evaporated and the fuel tank cap replaced before restarting engine."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: What does 1910.178(k)(4) require while dockboards or bridge plates are in position on railroad cars?

options.A: That the railroad car's brakes be released
options.B: That the truck's horn be sounded every minute
options.C: Positive protection to prevent the railroad cars from being moved
options.D: That a traffic cone be set on the dockboard

questions.explanation: "Positive protection shall be provided to prevent railroad cars from being moved while dockboards or bridge plates are in position."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: When must the flooring of trucks, trailers and railroad cars be checked for breaks and weakness?

options.A: Only when the trailer is not coupled to a tractor
options.B: After the loading is finished
options.C: Once a month
options.D: Before they are driven onto

questions.explanation: The flooring "shall be checked for breaks and weakness before they are driven onto."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Which areas does 1910.178(m)(14) say shall be kept clear?

options.A: Only the battery charging area
options.B: Fire aisles, access to stairways, and fire equipment
options.C: Only the truck parking spaces
options.D: Only the edge of the loading dock

questions.explanation: The rule states: "Fire aisles, access to stairways, and fire equipment shall be kept clear."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: When does 1910.178(e)(2) require the user to equip a fork truck with a vertical load backrest extension?

options.A: Only when the truck is used outdoors
options.B: If the type of load presents a hazard
options.C: Only when the truck travels on grades
options.D: Only when the truck carries a passenger

questions.explanation: "If the type of load presents a hazard, the user shall equip fork trucks with a vertical load backrest extension" manufactured in accordance with paragraph (a)(2).

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: The operator is dismounted and within 25 ft. of the truck, which is still in view. What does 1910.178(m)(5)(iii) require?

options.A: Nothing, because the truck is attended
options.B: Only that the power be shut off
options.C: Load engaging means fully lowered, controls neutralized and brakes set
options.D: Forks raised to clear the floor and the horn sounded

questions.explanation: In that case "the load engaging means shall be fully lowered, controls neutralized, and the brakes set to prevent movement."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: A truck is equipped with an attachment but is not handling a load. How does 1910.178(o)(4) say it is to be operated?

options.A: Only in reverse
options.B: As an empty truck, with no special care
options.C: Only with the attachment raised to full height
options.D: As a partially loaded truck

questions.explanation: "Trucks equipped with attachments shall be operated as partially loaded trucks when not handling a load."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: How must a motorized hand truck enter an elevator or other confined area under 1910.178(n)(13)?

options.A: With the load end forward
options.B: Sideways, to save space
options.C: Only after the load has been removed
options.D: With the load end trailing

questions.explanation: The rule states: "Motorized hand trucks must enter elevator or other confined areas with load end forward."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: What does 1910.178(q)(10) say about solvents used to clean industrial trucks?

options.A: Any solvent may be used if the truck is cleaned outdoors
options.B: Only gasoline may be used, because it removes grease best
options.C: Low flash point (below 100 °F.) solvents shall not be used
options.D: Solvents must be used in place of noncombustible agents

questions.explanation: "Noncombustible agents should be used for cleaning trucks. Low flash point (below 100 °F.) solvents shall not be used. High flash point (at or above 100 °F.) solvents may be used."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: What must be done before repairs are made to a truck's electrical system?

options.A: The battery is fully charged
options.B: The truck is moved into a Class I location
options.C: The battery is disconnected
options.D: The fuel tank is filled

questions.explanation: "Trucks in need of repairs to the electrical system shall have the battery disconnected prior to such repairs."
